radius.$description: Corner radius scale from 1 (2px) to 7 (32px); the key is the step, and circle makes a pill or circle.

style.$description: Border line styles, keyed by their CSS name.

width.$description: Border width scale; the key is the width in pixels (2 is 0.125rem, 2px).

shadow.$description: Shadow scale from 1 (subtle) to 6 (deepest), plus none; the key is the elevation step.

zIndex.$description: Stacking order: 1–5 are 10–50 for layers within the page, 6–8 are 1000 and up for overlays.

opacity.$description: Opacity scale; the key is the percentage (50 is 0.5).

dimension.$description: The one dimension scale on the 4px grid; the key is the multiple of 4px (12 is 3rem, 48px). Replaces the parallel base.size and base.spacing scales (#188).

size.$description: Size keywords (auto, full, screen, min, max, fit). The numbered steps are deprecated aliases of base.dimension.

color.$description: Colour palette: the grey ramp, six role ramps (accent, success, warning, serious, danger, ai) and four display ramps (olive, periwinkle, rose, magenta), each with alpha twins (decisions 0040, 0043 and 0044); the older neutral ramp and seven older hue ramps, removed in 3.0; white (decision 0049); and transparent.

transparent.$description: Fully transparent. For colour values that must not show, such as a border that keeps its width (semantic.color.border.none).

white.$description: Pure white, outside the ramps: raised surfaces (semantic.surface.raised) that sit on the gray.100 page. The ramps' contrast is measured against it (decision 0049).

gray.$description: Pure-grey ramp, defined in OKLCH (chroma 0): 100 (lightest) to 1200 (primary text). Each step has one job, and its contrast against white is in its description (decision 0040).

fontFamily.$description: Font stacks keyed by role: heading, body and monospace.

monospace.$value: Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, Courier New, monospace

fontSize.$description: Type size scale from 1 (0.75rem, 12px) to 10 (5rem, 80px); the key is the step.

fontWeight.$description: Font weight scale from 1 (300, light) to 7 (900, black); the key is the step.

6.$description: Extra Bold — for page titles and primary display headings per VDL (800–900 weight range)

7.$description: Black/Ultra Bold — maximum heading weight for the most dominant display headings per VDL

lineHeight.$description: Line height scale from 1 (1rem) to 11 (5rem), plus none (1, the font size); the key is the step.

letterSpacing.$description: Letter spacing from 0 (tightest, -0.125rem) to 4 (widest, 0.125rem); 2 is normal.

breakpoint.$description: Viewport widths where layouts change, from xs (0) to 2xl (1536px), keyed by size.

duration.$description: Animation durations from instant (0ms) to slowest (1000ms), keyed by speed.

easing.$description: Timing functions keyed by their CSS name; the Quart and Back curves are stronger variants.
